mentions.name: Text-based softball league simulator
mentions.description: A text-based softball league simulator where you forcibly enlist friends and family to join your co-ed softball team and play as their manager, coach, and fellow player. Every aspect of the games is narrated in real time; it is currently in prototype stage and has already produced some hilarious interactions.
